questions.question: Which service should be used to estimate the costs of running a new project on AWS?
questions.explanation: To estimate the cost of a NEW project before you build it, use the AWS Pricing Calculator (formerly the Simple Monthly Calculator). Cost Explorer analyzes your EXISTING usage, the TCO Calculator compares on-premises vs AWS, and Budgets only alerts on spend.

questions.question: Which service would provide network connectivity in a hybrid architecture that includes the AWS Cloud?
questions.explanation: AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated private network link between an on-premises data center and AWS — the connectivity backbone of a hybrid architecture. Amazon VPC is the cloud network itself, not the hybrid link.
